about: Medi's answers to the 'Medi?' moments of the one lesson ledger (LS-11, scripts/lesson_ledger.py). Hand-made: one row per answer, never deleted; a changed answer is a new row later in the list. conflict = the question's id (data/lesson-work/ledger/<date>.json needs_medi), answer = one of its options, quote = his words, rule = 'LS-11'.
